activity.role: Senior Shimazu commander and traditional 17th clan head
activity.notes: Yoshihiro was a major Shimazu daimyo and commander. Traditional genealogies count him as the 17th clan head from 1587 to 1602, but modern discussion notes that his elder brother Yoshihisa may have retained the effective headship. ATLAS therefore preserves the conventional interval as senior leadership activity rather than asserting an uncontested succession.

sources.title: Shimazu Yoshihiro — biographical summary
sources.citation_text: Lists the traditional 1587–1602 headship while noting that current interpretations question whether Yoshihiro actually displaced Yoshihisa as effective clan head.
